phases.title: Pipeline empty-state hint
phases.desired_end_state: When 'Actively working' is empty, show a quiet one-line hint instead of self-hiding. GUINEA-PIG for the first live P4 closeout dogfood — promote this through the board to Launch. Spec: agents/beacon/specs/projects-v3-pipeline-empty-state.md (repo ourliberty-dashboard).

closeout.summary: The projects board now greets an empty 'Actively working' area with a quiet one-line nudge telling people how to start, instead of showing nothing. This was also our first real test of the automatic phase-closeout, so the next phase can lean on that closeout flow with more confidence.
closeout.shipped: When no projects are active, the board shows the 'Actively working' heading plus a single faint line: 'Nothing here yet — Promote an item from the funnel to start a project.' When projects are active, the board looks exactly as it did before. Delivered in PR #66.
closeout.changed_vs_spec: It matched the plan — a subtle, single muted line with no new buttons, cards, or colors, and the populated view left untouched. One caveat: the automated tests couldn't be run in the build environment, so the test pass was left to be confirmed in CI.
closeout.learnings: This phase was deliberately small and easily reversible so it could prove out the build-to-done closeout process before a bigger feature relies on it. The live board checks — empty-state hint, unchanged populated view, and the completion handoff — still need a real eyes-on confirmation since they can't be verified automatically.
